configuration.title: LSPF Analysis
config.health.complexityThreshold: Cognitive complexity scoring 50%. Scores the control-flow pillar alongside cyclomatic complexity; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse.
config.health.cyclomaticThreshold: Cyclomatic complexity scoring 50%. Scores the control-flow pillar alongside cognitive complexity; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse. McCabe's recommended upper bound is 10.
config.health.lengthThreshold: Statements (logical lines) scoring 50%. The only measure of the size pillar.
config.health.workingMemoryThreshold: Names held at once scoring 50%. Scores the vocabulary-load pillar alongside Halstead difficulty; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse.
config.health.halsteadDifficultyThreshol: Halstead difficulty scoring 50%. Scores the vocabulary-load pillar alongside working memory; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse.
config.health.weights.complexity: Weight of the control-flow pillar in the quality blend. Weights are normalized by their sum, so only their ratio matters.
config.health.weights.length: Weight of the size pillar in the quality blend.
config.health.weights.workingMemory: Weight of the vocabulary-load pillar in the quality blend.
config.health.weights.interface: Weight of the interface pillar in the quality blend. Half the others by default: a wide signature is a real signal, but a narrower one than the three pillars describing what a function does.
config.health.parametersThreshold: Parameter count scoring 50%. The only measure of the interface pillar.
config.health.weights.classDesign: How much a file's classes weigh against its functions. Only applies to languages whose class-level metrics are computed, which today means Java.
config.health.wmcThreshold: Weighted methods per class scoring 50%. A measure of the class-design pillar.
config.health.publicMethodsThreshold: Public methods per class scoring 50%. A measure of the class-design pillar.
config.health.publicAttributesThreshold: Public attributes per class scoring 50%. A measure of the class-design pillar.
config.health.qualityWarn: Quality below this is reported as a warning.
config.health.qualityError: Quality below this is reported as an error rather than a warning.
config.diagnostics.enabled: Publish diagnostics at all. Turning this off clears what is displayed.
config.diagnostics.perMetric: Also report a function whose quality passes but which has one badly scoring pillar, as a hint.
config.diagnostics.file: Also report the file as a whole when its quality is bad enough to be an error.
config.statusBar.enabled: Show the active file's overall quality in the status bar.
config.server.path: Path to an `lspf-analysis` binary to use instead of the one packaged with this extension. A leading `~` is expanded.
config.trace.server: Trace the messages exchanged with the language server.
